mapper.sql: SELECT e.id,u.username,e.emp_code,e.emp_name,e.dept_id,d.dept_name,e.position,e.phone,e.email,e.status,0 AS read_only,e.create_time FROM sys_employee e LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=e.user_id AND u.is_deleted=0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id=e.dept_id AND d.is_deleted=0 WHERE e.is_deleted=0 UNION ALL SELECT -u.id,u.username,CONCAT('USR-',u.username),u.real_name,sd.id,COALESCE(sd.dept_name,'系统管理部'), CASE WHEN u.role='superadmin' THEN '系统超级管理员' ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(d.dept_name,'部门'),'系统管理员') END, u.phone,u.email,u.status,1,u.create_time FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id=u.dept_id AND d.is_deleted=0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON sd.dept_code='system_management' AND sd.is_deleted=0 WHERE u.is_deleted=0 AND u.role IN ('admin','superadmin')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM () directory ORDER BY create_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
